verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, renumbers the survivors with an injective old-to-new map into a fresh dict so no collision can occur, passes the 4 non-block tensors through untouched, and preserves values, shapes and dtypes. The assertions run before any write and cover the required checks: the surviving layer index set must equal exactly {0..11}, which rules out any block 12 to 15 and guarantees exactly 12 blocks, and the tensor count must be 184. Output goes to `out/T1/model.safetensors` as a single file.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
